item.name: accounts
item.description: Customer sign-up, sign-in, sign-out and profile.

description.content: Creates a customer and a session, and answers with the token and the customer. The email is unique without regard to case; the password is 8 to 72 bytes and is stored as a bcrypt hash of cost 12. Every attempt counts against its email and its client IP: the eleventh attempt for one email within an hour, or the hundred and first from one IP, answers 429.

item.name: admin-staff

description.content: Creates a session for an active staff user and answers its token and the staff user. Staff sessions end 12 hours after sign-in and use does not extend them. A wrong password, an unknown email, a customer's email and an inactive staff user answer the same 401. Shares the sign-in rate limit: attempts count per email and per client IP.

The core service: catalogue, carts, orders and accounts for the ShopperStop storefront and admin panel. Every error is the envelope {"error": {code, message, field?}}. Routes that need a signed-in customer take Authorization: Bearer <token>, the token that sign-in or register returned.
